Message:
“Judgement. Death.
Both in the upright position...
A great decision awaits you—
one that will become the blade to
sever the binds of confinement.

But, tread with caution. For
hesitation will forfeit any chance
of rebirth to the sands of time.

The way fate unfolds...
depends on your decision.”

Back then, even though
I felt something was amiss
with Lady Elfriede,
all I could do was obey her.

But, all I did was
make her suffer even more...

What I truly should have done
back then was...

I feel as if something bad
is on the verge of happening.
The same as during
the Witch Hunt...
The same?

No, that’s not possible.
After all, the demon
should no longer...

But wait—
demons toy with humans.
So maybe...
